exposure: Hyaluronate-carboxycellulose barrier film used during primary cesarean vs not used
prior use of a sodium hyaluronate-carboxycellulose adhesion barrier
Use of hyaluronate-carboxycellulose adhesion barrier during primary cesarean delivery
cohort: 97 women undergoing first repeat cesarean delivery
finding: There was no difference in delivery time, blood loss, or adhesion scores at first repeat cesarean delivery between women who had hyaluronate-carboxycellulose barrier film placed at the time of their primary cesarean delivery and those who did not.
